{{Quote|X-wing Blue is stranded in space. Watch over him until help arrives.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="XW" />|audio=DarklighterRescue-XW.flac}}
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] dispatched forces to '''rescue''' [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] after his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] broke down near the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] while carrying the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].

==Prelude==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1BBY" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Ambush in the Cron Drift|deployed]] stolen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[communications satellite]]s near the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] in the hopes of tapping into the Imperial communications network. One of the satellites intercepted the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an armored [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] capable of destroying a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and transmitted them to Rebel outpost [[AX-235]].<ref name="XW" />

Due to the importance of the information,<ref name="XW" /> the Alliance dispatched [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]<ref name="OSG" /> in a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] to retrieve it. However, after leaving AX-235, Darklighter's X-wing broke down near the Cron Drift.<ref name="XW" /> The [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] sent three<ref name="OSG" /> [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|A-wings]],<ref name="R22" /> led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]],<ref name="OSG" /> to protect him while his X-wing was repaired.<ref name="XW" />

==The battle==
Shortly after the Rebel fighters emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] entered the area. While the Rebels [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] the new arrivals, Imperial [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] attempted to capture the disabled X-wing. [[Red Three/Legends|Red Three]] was destroyed during the battle, but the remaining R-22's were able to eliminate the last of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] before it could capture the X-wing. Eventually, the Rebel ''Lambda''-class shuttle [[Rescue 1 (Lambda-class)|''Rescue 1'']] arrived, escorted by three [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]]. ''Rescue 1'' repaired Darklighter's X-wing and the Rebels escaped into hyperspace.<ref name="OSG" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|"It was an adequate mission, but you didn't take advantage of the safety area near the corvettes. Their extra cannons would have made an excellent killing zone to draw the Imperial fighters into. It would also have made you a much more difficult target to get a missile lock on.''"<br />"''I lost another wingman, too.''"<br />"''Yes, you did. Mission analysis suggests that Red 3 failed to rebalance shields after that first missile hit him. It wasn't your fault, captain.|[[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Lagrane]] debriefs Keyan Farlander|<ref name="OSG" />}}
Darklighter returned to the ''Independence'' for debriefing<ref name="OSG" /> and [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous]] [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Command]] began working on a plan to get the plans to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].<ref name="XW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], in the seventh mission of "Tour of Duty II: The Great Search", "Protect a Disabled X-wing." If the player fails to prevent Darklighter's X-wing being captured by one of the Imperial shuttles, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Intrepid (Imperial I-class)|''Intrepid'']] arrives to retrieve it.<ref name="XW" /> However, Farlander's after-action report in ''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' confirms that all three shuttles were destroyed and the ''Intrepid'' did not enter the battle.<ref name="OSG" />
